response.query: Which re-identification risk models and attacker assumptions (prosecutor/marketer) give actionable metrics like proportion quasi-unique and re-id probability?
response.answer: Re-identification risk models like k-anonymity and l-diversity provide actionable metrics like quasi-unique proportion and re-id probability for prosecutor/marketer attackers. These metrics help assess the risk of re-identification in datasets.

results.content: Finally, the third part offers an in-depth treatment of selected topics that are critical for organizations intending to use AI systems in accordance with the requirements of data protection law. Law & Compliance in AI Security & Data Protection 231 Regulatory sandboxes in the AI Act The AI Act includes some additional mechanisms for supporting organizations that intend to deploy AI systems. Conclusion to Unit 14 The final unit of this training module has covered some tools and mechanisms that AI providers and deployers can use for making sense of the legal requirements in the GDPR and the AI Act. Because these legal instruments are designed to cover all sorts of circumstances, they cannot offer detailed guidance about every use case or technology.
